$comment: Authored component catalog = the Design agent's bounded vocabulary. `scripts/generate-manifest.mjs` stamps this into manifest.json and validates it against the public exports. Add an entry before exporting a component from src/index.ts; flip `status` to "available" once its source exists.
name: @agiler/ui
rules: Compose screens only from components declared here; never write raw CSS, hex colours or inline styles.
Use the tokens in tokens.css (or a per-order theme.json override) for every visual value.
Pin an exact @agiler/ui version per order; structure is identical everywhere, brand comes from theme tokens.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Primary action control with variants, sizes, loading state and icon slots.
a11y: Sets aria-busy while loading and disables the control.

components.name: Card
components.summary: Surface container with optional header/footer and padding scale.
a11y: Use `as` to keep landmarks/headings semantic (e.g. as="article", as="section").

components.name: Badge
components.summary: Compact status/label chip with semantic variants.
a11y: Purely presentational; pair with text that carries the meaning.

components.name: Spinner
components.summary: Indeterminate loading indicator.
a11y: role="status" + aria-live="polite"; the label is announced.

components.name: IconButton
components.summary: Square icon-only button; requires an aria-label.

components.name: Alert
components.summary: Inline message with title, body and semantic variant.

components.summary: Transient notification surfaced via a viewport/provider.
